options.name: allowed_uses_per_key
options.description: The number of times pairing profile keys can be used. By default, each key has unlimited uses.

options.name: api_key_secret
options.description: Illumio PCE API key secret. Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_API_KEY_SECRET).

options.name: api_key_username
options.description: Illumio PCE API key username. Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_API_KEY_USERNAME).

options.name: app_label_lock
options.description: If set to C(false), allows the app label to be overridden when pairing.

options.name: description
options.description: Pairing profile description.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Determines whether or not the profile is enabled for pairing.

options.name: enforcement_mode
options.description: Pairing profile default enforcement mode. VENs paired using this profile will be put into the provided enforcement mode by default. C(idle): the VEN will not take control of the host firewall. C(visibility_only): no traffic will be blocked by PCE policy. C(selective): segmentation rules are enforced only for selected inbound services when the host is within the scope of an enforcement boundary. C(full): segmentation rules are enforced for all inbound and outbound services. Traffic that is not al

options.name: enforcement_mode_lock
options.description: If set to C(false), allows the enforcement mode to be overridden when pairing.

options.name: env_label_lock
options.description: If set to C(false), allows the environment label to be overridden when pairing.

options.name: external_data_reference
options.description: External data reference identifier. Must be set if using C(external_data_set).

options.name: external_data_set
options.description: External data set identifier. Must be set if using C(external_data_reference).

options.name: href
options.description: HREF of an existing pairing profile.

options.name: key_lifespan
options.description: The number of seconds pairing profile keys will be valid for. By default, each key lasts an unlimited amount of time.

options.name: labels
options.description: List of default labels to apply to workloads paired using this profile. Labels can only be referenced by HREF, and only one Label of each type can be specified.

options.name: loc_label_lock
options.description: If set to C(false), allows the location label to be overridden when pairing.

options.name: name
options.description: Pairing profile display name. Required for creating a pairing profile or when HREF is not specified.

options.name: pce_hostname
options.description: URL or FQDN of Illumio Policy Compute Engine. C(pce_url) is an alias for C(pce_hostname). Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_PCE_HOST).

options.name: pce_http_proxy
options.description: HTTP proxy server to use when connecting to the PCE. If not set, it will use the default C(http_proxy) environment variable.

options.name: pce_https_proxy
options.description: HTTPS proxy server to use when connecting to the PCE. If not set, it will use the default C(https_proxy) environment variable.

options.name: pce_org_id
options.description: PCE Organization ID. Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_PCE_ORG_ID).

options.name: pce_port
options.description: HTTP(S) port used by the PCE. Can be set with the environment variable C(ILLUMIO_PCE_PORT).

options.name: pce_tls_ca
options.description: Path to a custom root CA certificate bundle to use for the PCE connection. If set, overrides C(pce_tls_verify).

options.name: pce_tls_client_certs
options.description: Optional paths to client-side certificate files. May point to separate cert and private key files or a PEM bundle containing both.

options.name: pce_tls_verify
options.description: Flag denoting whether TLS verification should be enabled on the PCE connection.

options.name: role_label_lock
options.description: If set to C(false), allows the role label to be overridden when pairing.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired pairing profile state. If C(present), the profile will be created if it does not exist, or updated to match the provided parameters if it does. If C(absent), the profile will be removed if it exists.

options.name: ven_version
options.description: Optional parameter to set the VEN version used by this pairing profile. If not set, the profile will use the default VEN version configured in the PCE's VEN library.

options.name: visibility_level
options.description: Determines what traffic will be logged by VENs paired with this profile. C(flow_summary): log connection information for allowed, blocked, and potentially blocked traffic. C(flow_drops): log connection information for blocked and potentially blocked traffic. C(flow_off): do not log any traffic information. C(enhanced_data_collection): log byte counts in addition to connection details for all traffic.

options.name: visibility_level_lock
options.description: If set to C(false), allows the visibility level to be overridden when pairing.
